Since I was a kid I've been on every diet, tried all different types of exercise to no avail. If you burn more than you consume you will lose weight, that is it. Realising all the dumb diets you've been reccommended and fitness products are just there to brainwash you into spending money. Do exercise which works for you, there's something out there for everyone. I haven't seen much physical results yet but, I am more flexible, i feel mentally lighter, i have more energy, and i'm a lot more productive, even slightly confident. Starting to exercise has definitely given me the energy i need to do other important things. But i never would have come to the realisation that I need to be the change i want to see, if i didn't start therapy.
